questions.prompt: The old man had eight grandsons and five granddaughters.
questions.answer: Senex octō nepōtēs et quīnque neptēs habēbat.

questions.prompt: On the tenth day the exhausted envoys reached the camp.
questions.answer: Decimō diē lēgātī fessī ad castra pervēnērunt.

questions.prompt: Three denarii each were given to the soldiers by the commander.
questions.answer: Singulīs mīlitibus ternī dēnāriī ā duce datī sunt.

questions.prompt: At first light nine ships set sail from the harbor.
questions.answer: Prīmā lūce novem nāvēs ex portū solvērunt.

questions.prompt: In the second hour the noisy crowd gathered in the forum.
questions.answer: Secundā hōrā turba strepēns in forō convēnit.

questions.prompt: The king ruled for forty years with justice and clemency.
questions.answer: Rēx quadrāgintā annōs cum iūstitiā et clēmentiā rēgnāvit.

questions.prompt: In the fifth watch the enemy, silent and hidden, attacked the camp.
questions.answer: Quīntā vigiliā hostēs tacitī et occultī castra oppugnāvērunt.

questions.prompt: Eleven captives, bound with chains, were led into the city.
questions.answer: Ūndecim captīvī catēnīs vīnctī in urbem ductī sunt.

questions.prompt: The first cohort held the hill; the second guarded the gate.
questions.answer: Prīma cohors collem tenuit; secunda portam custōdīvit.

questions.prompt: The queen reigned for thirty years, dreadful to all her neighbors.
questions.answer: Rēgīna trīgintā annōs rēgnāvit, omnibus fīnitimīs formīdolōsa.

questions.prompt: The boy read the same book six times with great delight.
questions.answer: Puer eundem librum sexiēns magnō cum lepōre lēgit.

questions.prompt: The old man distributed a thousand coins, giving ten to each.
questions.answer: Senex mīlle nummōs distribuit, dēnōs cuique dāns.

questions.prompt: Having drunk the first cup, the guest praised the host with few words.
questions.answer: Prīmō pōculō ēpōtō, hospes dominum paucīs verbīs laudāvit.

questions.prompt: The eighteenth legion, hidden in the woods, awaited the signal in silence.
questions.answer: Duodēvīcēsima legiō in silvīs occultāta signum tacita exspectābat.

questions.prompt: The king distributed ten talents each to the victorious leaders.
questions.answer: Rēx dēna talenta ducibus victōribus distribuit.

questions.prompt: For the third time the orator, indignant, denounced the crime openly.
questions.answer: Tertium ōrātor indignāns crīmen palam dēnūntiāvit.
